visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white shirt and gold hoop earrings, stands in front of a dark wall with floral drawings. She holds a smartphone displaying the Spotify app interface and rests against a large yellow plush pillow. She speaks with expressive facial movements and shifts her gaze between the phone and the camera. (2) Extreme close-up of the smartphone screen showing the Spotify music player. A finger with white nail polish drags a progress bar which features a small Hello Kitty character icon instead of a standard dot. The album art for 2NE1's 'I Am the Best' is visible. (3) Screen recording of the Spotify search interface. The user types 'Hello Kitty' into the search bar, and various search suggestions appear, including 'Hello Kitty 50th Anniversary'. (4) The screen scrolls through the 'Hello Kitty 50th Anniversary' playlist, showing various tracks. Small Hello Kitty icons appear next to the song titles. A brief shot shows a music video clip of Jolin Tsai. (5) A graphic transition appears with yellow text on a white background. The woman returns to the frame, holding the phone and yellow pillow, pointing at the screen. (6) Screen recording of the Instagram Story interface. A photo of several plush rabbits serves as the background. The user selects the music sticker, picks the song 'My Dearest' by xooos, and toggles through playback styles until a spinning vinyl record design appears. (7) Final shot of the woman holding the phone and the large yellow pillow. She smiles brightly at the camera and uses hand gestures to encourage the audience to try the features.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: Spotify 超可愛小功能. [Subtitle]: 還不知道就白訂閱了. (2) [Variety]: 想要看到這特別的 Kitty 拉桿嗎? (3) [Subtitle]: 只要點選搜尋. [Subtitle]: 打上 Hello Kitty. (4) [Subtitle]: 看到 50th Anniversary. (5) [Subtitle]: 進到歌單之後 裡面的每一首歌. [Subtitle]: 就都會配有 Kitty 的小頭像喔. (6) [Subtitle]: 連 Jolin 的中文歌也有耶. (7) [Variety]: 加碼小技巧!. (8) [Variety]: 這個好玩. [Subtitle]: 復古又簡單的 IG 限動刷碟. (9) [Subtitle]: 先從圖片庫選一張背景照片. [Subtitle]: 點右上角的音符. (10) [Subtitle]: 挑好一首歌 按右下方的箭頭. (11) [Subtitle]: 之後滑到最右邊的選項. [Subtitle]: 會看見黑膠唱片的樣式出現. (12) [Subtitle]: 再按完成 最後發佈就可以啦. (13) [Subtitle]: 這樣大家就都能在你的限時動態 刷碟 Play 音樂了. (14) [Subtitle]: 你自己愛怎麼玩就怎麼玩. (15) [Subtitle]: 趕快分享給還不知道的朋友吧.
